subject: Guest arrival + slide ingest: preflight & day-of timeline
body:
---EMAIL THREAD START---
From: Olivia Park <olivia@techpartners.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Event Ops <ops@eventco.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood x TechPartners — speaker travel and slides

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the run-of-show draft. Quick question about logistics: flights now land at 1:20pm on Wed 2/24, hotel ETA ~2:10pm. Is there still a 3:30pm speaker check window on-site or should we plan for a 4:00pm mic check?

Also attaching a final bio and a lightly edited slide deck (v3).

Olivia

Attachments:
- guest-bio.docx (bio)
- slide-deck-v3.pptx (pptx)

-----
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Park <olivia@techpartners.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Event Ops <ops@eventco.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood x TechPartners — speaker travel and slides

Hi Olivia — great, thanks for the attachments. Short answers:
- On-site mic check: we have a flexible window, but recommend 4:00pm so AV has time to switch between panels. Please plan for 4:00pm arrival to the green room.
- Slide ingest: can you confirm the deck has embedded fonts? We'll do a handoff to AV at 4:15pm and upload to our staging laptop (formats accepted: pptx/pdf).

Marissa — can you own the physical handoff and confirm the staging laptop has PowerPoint 2019 and the corporate fonts installed?
Dylan — I'll need you to confirm the wireless lapel mic and backup handheld availability.

Sooj

-----
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Olivia Park <olivia@techpartners.com>, Event Ops <ops@eventco.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Feb 2027 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood x TechPartners — speaker travel and slides

Soojin,

Confirming I will handle slide staging and laptop setup. Two notes:
- I verified corp fonts (Inter, Source Sans) are on the staging laptop. If Olivia's deck uses custom fonts, please provide a PDF as backup.
- I'll meet Olivia at the green room at 3:55pm to do a quick run-through of the first two slides and confirm transitions.

I'll attach the hotel arrival sheet to this thread once Ops sends it.

-Marissa
Event Producer
Redwood Inference

-----
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Olivia Park <olivia@techpartners.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Feb 2027 11:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: mic check / spare mics

Quick update — wireless lapel: 2 batteries charged, one spare. Handheld: tested with console and cleared RF channels. I'll bring an extra lavalier cable and a spare handheld capsule.

I also arranged for AV to import slide-deck-v3.pptx to staging at 4:15pm and to generate a PDF copy (slide-deck-v3.pdf) for the confidence monitor.

-Dylan

-----
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Park <olivia@techpartners.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Event Ops <ops@eventco.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2027 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood x TechPartners — speaker travel and slides

Final day-of checklist below (please read and ack):

Day-of timeline (Wed 2/24):
- 14:10 — Olivia arrives hotel lobby (based on flight ETA)
- 15:30 — Venue doors open for speakers; green room access
- 15:55 — Marissa meets Olivia in green room for quick slate + water
- 16:00 — Full AV/mic check on stage (lapel + handheld) — Dylan
- 16:15 — Slide ingest to staging laptop (pptx + pdf) — Marissa + AV
- 16:30 — Producer cue and stage walk (10 minutes)
- 17:00 — Program start

Please confirm: reply ALL with 'ACK' if schedule works, or propose alternate time (we can shift mic check to 16:30 latest).

Thanks everyone — looking forward to a tight show.

Soojin Lee
Events Program Manager
Redwood Inference

---EMAIL THREAD END---
